steps.title: swing as a number
steps.body:
Play 16th hats. Swing is how long the first 16th of each pair lasts, as a share of the pair: 50% is straight, about 67% is a triplet shuffle.

The target is 54 to 62%: felt, not bouncy. The score is your measured swing from the offsets of every second 16th, not the milliseconds of each hit.
